prompt:
You are designing a premium, commercially desirable SaaS product, not a default ERP admin template. FMC is a food manufacturing operations product for spice and masala brands. Create an elegant art-directed product interface with effortless readability. DESIGN AT 1440 CSS PIXELS DESKTOP, viewport about 1050px high. Body text 15px minimum, table data 14px minimum, page heading 32px, KPI numbers 38px. Do not shrink to fit excessive data. Use a refined warm ivory canvas #F7F8F5, white cards, dark pine ink #172E28, muted gray-green secondary text #738078, deep forest accent #24634D and soft sage #EAF1E8. Amber only for attention and red only for real issues. Thin neutral borders, 14px card radii, very subtle shadows, 24-32px padding, 24px section gaps. Typography Manrope or Inter, modern confident medium weights, tabular numbers. Crisp Lucide-style outline icons. Absolutely no gradients, photos, decorative illustrations, neon, glass, tiny uppercase data everywhere, cramped tables, excessive badge soup, thick borders, machine telemetry or fake live status. Visual quality on par with carefully crafted modern paid B2B software. Design for sale to serious business owners.
SHARED SHELL: 216px WHITE sidebar, strong small forest-green FMC monogram and FMC wordmark with quiet Food operations subtitle. Simple nav Overview, Production, Quality with small count12, Receiving, Dispatch, Recall; only one active with sage background and forest text. Sidebar lower area a small static Spice & masala operations descriptor, no invented settings buttons or user profile. 72px topbar with company selector FM Demo Foods, breadcrumb. Main area max-width 1160, 32px horizontal padding. No global search, emergency stop, shift selector, printing, revenue, settings, machines or other unsupported controls. Keep this shell identical across the two screens. All visible copy calm, short and useful. User actions should be obvious; information should breathe.
SCREEN: Production Console, desktop 1440 CSS px. Same white 216px sidebar, sage active Production, warm ivory canvas, forest green actions and generous whitespace as the project's premium Overview. Main header large Production, subtitle From released ingredients to finished batches, right quiet Refresh. Elegant two-panel workspace: 280px Work orders panel left with title Open work orders and 3 calm selectable order cards, active WO-FM-0028 Garam Masala Bulk, planned500kg, 0kg completed, In process; other cards packaging50g packs and Turmeric blending, no machine telemetry. Main panel selected run header small WO-FM-0028 and understated In process badge, large Garam Masala Bulk and quiet Blending · BOM-GM-004, with three airy summary columns Planned500kg, Already produced0kg, Remaining500kg. Next white card Ingredients & available lots with title and quiet Released stock, earliest expiry first. A VERY readable clean table 4 rows: Chilli Powder required300kg consumed0kg lotCHI-014 available450kg exp12Jan2027; Cumin required125kg consumed0kg lotCUM-009 available180kg exp20Feb2027; Coriander required50kg consumed0kg lotCOR-021 available90kg exp11Mar2027; Black Pepper required25kg consumed0kg lotPEP-006 available40kg exp15Apr2027. Table columns Ingredient, Required, Consumed, Released lot, Available, Expiry. Show exact quantities only, no recipe percentages or editable allocation feature not currently supported. A small clear helper for no released stock state, but do not show a false stock block for these rows. Below a spacious Finish this run card, subtitle Record actual output and non-recoverable loss. Two large side-by-side labeled number inputs Good output487 kg and Process loss13 kg; third full-width optional Output batch text input with helper Leave blank for automatic batch naming. Calm summary Good output and loss will be posted to this Work Order, no speculative yield formula before server response. Bottom right strong forest primary Complete run and secondary Back to work orders. No extra unsupported actions, no recipe target, downtime, signature, line controls or analytics. The selection panel and task form should make this pleasant and obvious for a real operator. Strong typography, very little chrome, 16px table row text, larger 44px form controls, no tiny text. Generate complete polished screen now.
